title: MachPhy: Cool Glide to Funding
summary: Kahran and Divya do a slide-by-slide review of MachPhy Solutions' active fundraising deck — a hardtech company using advanced thermal materials to make industrial cooling cheaper. They critique how the deck establishes credibility before it explains the problem, how it underplays its core scientific breakthrough, and how a deeptech pitch should signal where in the product life cycle the investor is being asked to come in.

intents.display: to watch a hardtech investor deck get torn down live
